title: Credit account
description: Apply for credit, review limits and statements, and repay safely from the same-currency balance.
loadFailed: Credit information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

application.title: Submit credit application
application.help: Enter the requested limit and validity honestly. Evidence is visible only to authorized reviewers.
application.fileHelp: Up to 10 PDF, JPG, or PNG files; 20 MiB each and 200 MiB total.
application.fileRejected: The file type, size, or count is not allowed.
application.invalid: Enter a valid limit and dates, and upload at least one evidence file.
application.failed: The application was not submitted. Please try again.

repayment.title: Repay from balance
repayment.help: This statement has {amount} due; available same-currency balance is {balance}.
repayment.invalid: The amount must be positive and no greater than the outstanding amount.
repayment.success: Repayment completed and the limit was released for repaid principal.
repayment.failed: Repayment did not complete. Balance and statement remain unchanged.
